name: Tra Que Basil
subtitle: Calming Herb
mechanism: Aura (AuraPlant). Every pulse_interval s, every plant within aura_radius (itself included) becomes stun-immune for immune_duration s (PlantBase.grant_stun_immunity), which also clears a stun that already landed. immune_duration outlasts pulse_interval, so a Tourist Zombie's flash never sticks to covered plants.

abilities.name: Calming Scent
abilities.trigger: Every 0.5 s while enemies are on the field
abilities.effect: Plants within 3 m cannot be stunned for 0.8 s; current stuns are cleared.

clipAnnotations.idle: The bush sways; flower spikes breathe.
clipAnnotations.attack: Spikes stretch up when a pulse clears a stun.
clipAnnotations.die: Squash and shrink into the bed.
